messages.subject: Cannot Install StatEt on Eclipse 3.6
parts:
Hi.
I tried to install the StatEt plugin for editing R on Eclipse 3.6.
I followed the instructions in the StatET site:
http://www.walware.de/goto/statet

But got stuck with this error:
An error occurred while collecting items to be installed
session context was:(profile=epp.package.jee,
phase=org.eclipse.equinox.internal.p2.engine.phases.Collect, operand=,
action=).
No repository found containing: osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.datashare,
2.0.0.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing: osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.docshare,
2.1.0.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing: osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.presence,
2.0.0.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing:
osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.presence.ui,2.1.0.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing:
osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.sharedobject,2.2.100.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing: osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.sync,
2.0.0.v20100913-1814
No repository found containing: osgi.bundle,org.eclipse.ecf.ui,
2.1.0.v20100913-1814

Do you have an idea how to fix this?
Thanks in advance,
Yuval

messages.subject: Re: Cannot Install StatEt on Eclipse 3.6
parts:
לא הבנתי.
אם אתה מתכוון למקום של R בדיסק,
אז לא הגעתי לשלב הזה.

מה שעשיתי:
1. Help | Install New Software...
2. Work with: http://download.walware.de/eclipse-3.6
3. Select all
4. Next
5. Finish

Eclipse כותב:
Installing Software

ואז
Installing Software has encountered a problem
